tagline: Home of the Taj Mahal, Agra also has the red-sandstone Agra Fort and nearby Fatehpur Sikri, three UNESCO sites from the Mughal golden age.
overview: Agra sits on the Yamuna River in Uttar Pradesh and was the capital of the Mughal Empire under emperors Akbar, Jahangir and Shah Jahan. Its monuments make it one of the most visited places in India.

The Taj Mahal, built by Shah Jahan in memory of his wife Mumtaz Mahal, took around 20 years to complete and is one of the world's most famous buildings. Its white marble is inlaid with semi-precious stones, and its colour seems to change from dawn to dusk.

Upriver, the red-sandstone Agra Fort was the main Mughal residence; Shah Jahan spent his last years there looking out at the Taj. About 40 km away, Fatehpur Sikri is Akbar's abandoned capital. Agra is also known for petha, a translucent sweet, and marble inlay crafts.
